query: INSERT INTO tabac_terroir_links (tabac_id, terroir_id, soil_ph, soil_type, nitrogen_level, potassium_level, climate_notes, cultivation_notes) SELECT t.id, te.id, 6.2, 'Argileux rouge', 'Faible', 'Modere', 'Climat tempere humide Cfa - Sechage au feu indirect', 'Flue-curing pendant 5-7 jours' FROM tabacs t, terroirs te WHERE t.name LIKE '%Virginia%' AND te.name = 'Piedmont Virginia'; INSERT INTO tabac_terroir_links (tabac_id, terroir_id, soil_ph, soil_type, nitrogen_level, potassium_level, climate_notes, cultivation_notes) SELECT t.id, te.id, 6.5, 'Calcaire', 'Modere', 'Eleve', 'Climat continental humide Cfa - Fumage au feu de bois', 'Fire-curing pendant 4-6 semaines' FROM tabacs t, terroirs te WHERE t.name LIKE '%Kentucky%' AND te.name = 'Western Kentucky'; INSERT INTO tabac_terroir_links (tabac_id, terroir_id, soil_ph, soil_type, nitrogen_level, potassium_level, climate_notes, cultivation_notes) SELECT t.id, te.id, 7.2, 'Sableux cotier', 'Faible', 'Faible', 'Climat mediterraneen Csa - Fumage traditionnel aux herbes', 'Sun-curing puis fumage aux bois aromatiques locaux' FROM tabacs t, terroirs te WHERE t.name LIKE '%Latakia%' AND te.name = 'Latakia Coast';
